notes: A078173_max_t, A078173_max_s: for n >= 1, over positive r <= s <= t with rst = n(r+s+t), max t = n(n+2) (witness (1,n+1,n(n+2))) and max s = 2n (witness (1,2n,2n+1)). Key: t(rs-n) = n(r+s); r = 1 gives (s-n)(t-n) = n(n+1); r >= 2 uses 2(r+s) <= rs+4; s <= 2n from s(rs-2n) <= nr. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.
